test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically definitely follow's from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some Ducks are Chickens.

Some Chickens are Eggs.

All Eggs are Omelettes.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Ducks are Eggs.

(II) Some Chickens are Omelettes.

options.text: Both conclusions (I) and (II) definitely do not follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some Ducks are Chickens.

Some Chickens are Eggs.

All Eggs are Omelettes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48eb7398f6d3d9ac82a70039b00e5b06d780a5449ccbc868e25d4e892e9e2a23.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Ducks are Eggs - False (Because, No definite relation given between Ducks and Eggs, so Some Ducks are Eggs is possible only).

II. Some Chickens are Omelettes - True (Because, Some Chickens are Eggs and All Eggs are Omelettes, so those part of Chickens which is Eggs will Omelettes also).

So, Only conclusion (II) definitely follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
